notices.text: Local frame: 287 shower(s), one per event, superimposed at their own entry points, each rotated so its incident direction is +w. ⟨ρ⟩ is energy per event and per mm².

No cell-footprint comb measured on the raw local accumulation grid, before any display smoothing (worst lag-1 per axis: u +0.51, v +0.55, w +0.03); each cell was split into 6 × 6 × 2 rotated sub-deposits.

Bins below 10⁻³ of ρ_ref are not drawn (uv 242 bins holding 0.393% of its in-window energy; vw 175 bins holding 0.161% of its in-window energy; uw 67 bins holding 0.0775% of its in-window energy), so the outer edge of the colour is the display floor, not the edge of the shower. Bins with no energy at all are empty.

Colours are relative to this selection's own peak density on the raw 20 mm accumulation grid (stated in the panel's Details drawer), which the displayed field never exceeds; switch the density normalisation to the dataset peak to compare colours across selections.
w is each shower's incident direction by construction; no ensemble axis or Rayleigh statistic is drawn because none could carry information.

frame_mean.label: Mean per-event centroid (centroid_*_local), relative to the shower's entry point
frame_mean.dof_note: N = 287: SD with ddof = 1 and a Student-t 95% interval on 286 degrees of freedom.

centroid_dataset.label: Dataset centroid (absolute-frame per-event average; not drawn in the local frame - see centroids.frame_mean)

slab.note: The uv panel sums each shower's entrance slab: its own first 6 sampling layers (123 mm), counted from the layer holding its entry point, projected onto the plane perpendicular to its incident direction.

frame.anchor_note: Each hit is shifted by its own shower's entry point P0 - the energy-weighted x, y centroid of that shower's first populated layer, at that layer's depth - and rotated by that shower's R(θ, φ), so its incident direction is +w. One shower per event: there is no separation D.

depth.text: uniform bins of the layer pitch along w, never smoothed or interpolated

window.planned_from: dataset energy-weighted 10⁻⁴ and 0.9999 quantiles plus half a footprint

fit.note: Display windows are symmetric about the origin along u and v, each half-width covering the 0.1st to 99.9th energy percentile, never below 100 mm (a two-cell-footprint floor), and snapped outward to whole 20 mm bins. Up to 0.098% of a panel's energy lies outside its window on the raw accumulation grid; it is excluded from the view but not from the statistics. Depth is never cropped.

coordinates.note: Coordinates: the file's own x/y/z_local, as every response of this frame binned them; the same motion (R(θ, φ) of the shower applied to the laboratory position about its entry point P0) was applied to every hit inside the scan as a cross-check, and over this selection the two differ by at most 0.000234 mm (ingest-wide 0.000273 mm), within the 0.01 mm tolerance.

comb.measured_on: raw accumulation grid, before display smoothing
comb.note: No cell-footprint comb measured on the raw local accumulation grid, before any display smoothing (worst lag-1 per axis: u +0.51, v +0.55, w +0.03); each cell was split into 6 × 6 × 2 rotated sub-deposits.

rho.basis: peak of the raw 20 mm accumulation grid of this selection, before display reconstruction

reconstruction.label: none (raw bins)
reconstruction.depth: uniform bins of the layer pitch along w, never smoothed or interpolated
reconstruction.note: Native Grid: the raw 20 mm accumulation bins with no reconstruction, the audit view. Total transverse blur including the 6 × 6 × 2 rotated footprint sub-deposits and the 20 mm binning: 16.0 mm RMS in u, 16.1 mm in v.

intervals.hits_fraction: 95% Student-t, ratio of sums, events as clusters
intervals.energy_fraction: 95% Student-t, ratio of sums, events as clusters
intervals.showers_with_any: 95% Wilson score, showers (one per event only)

negative_w.summary: w < −10⁻⁶ mm: 7.12% [6.00, 8.23] of energy, 24.04% [21.43, 26.66] of hits; 49.8% [44.1, 55.6] of showers (95% intervals in brackets)
